create_TableColumn_attribute: create a TableColumn attribute to extract a named column value from each memory node
build_TripleWalk_attribute: build a TripleWalk attribute to traverse a path along the triples graph and return endpoint nodes
use_BBoxSize_attribute: use a BBoxSize attribute to compute bounding box height, width, or size for reference objects
create_LinearExtentAttribute: create a LinearExtentAttribute to compute signed or unsigned distance between two points in space
build_LookRayDistance_attribute: build a LookRayDistance attribute to compute distance from a reference object to an agent's look ray
